title: introduce-cost-weaver-automatic-batch-cache-curation
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: We continue to see tenant-level cost variance caused by conservative global defaults for batching, prefix caching, and quant profiles. This PR introduces 'Cost Weaver' — a light-weight automation layer that consumes per-tenant signals (latency SLOs, cold-start incidence, token distribution, and budget tiers) and emits curated defaults: batch shapes, cache window hints, and a recommended quant profile with a confidence score.

What this PR delivers: 1) runtime/cost_weaver.py: a service that computes tenant-specific defaults from recent telemetry and a configurable budget fabric policy; 2) cli/weaver_cli.py: an operator-facing dry-run and apply tool with --simulate and --rollback flags; 3) infra/telemetry/telemetry-mapping.yaml: mappings of the input signals used by the weaver; 4) docs/quickstarts/cost-weaver.md: short how-to and safety notes; 5) tests/test_cost_weaver.py + unit test harness for the dry-run simulator; 6) helm/values-weaver.yaml: small helm knobs for rollout percentage and safety thresholds.

Design notes: Cost Weaver is intentionally conservative by default. It produces a ranked list of candidate configurations (batch size / max latency budget / cache TTL / quant tier) and annotates each with a confidence score derived from sample size and recent stability. The control plane uses the score and tenant budget tier to either auto-apply the top candidate (for low-risk tiers) or suggest it in the console for manual approval (for high-risk/enterprise tiers). The runtime integrates a compact selector that validates compatibility (model architecture, KV cache availability, hardware capability) before enabling any change.

Safety and fallbacks: - Every applied change goes through a simulated dry-run using recent traces (cli --simulate). - Safety gates: min_latency_slo, max_cpu_pct_on_gpu_host, and quality_regression_thresholds are enforced. - Automatic rollback if 5xxs increase by >3% or token-level latency P95 regresses beyond configured window.

Testing and rollout plan: unit + integration tests included; staged rollout via helm percentage knob. Default rollout is off for enterprise tenants and on as a suggest-only mode for free/low-tier tenants. Manual QA performed on staging with synthetic traces mimicking microburst traffic patterns.

Related: ENG-4821 (tenant defaults initiative), ENG-5039 (budget fabric policy). Screenshots and console UX mockups are in the linked doc.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation of cost weaver algorithm and selectors. - [x] CLI dry-run and apply with rollback. - [x] Telemetry mapping + small schema addition (backwards compatible). - [x] Unit and integration tests. - [x] Docs and helm knobs.

Notes: This PR intentionally avoids touching the existing routing/fallback layer; instead it surfaces recommended configs through the existing rollout API. Full automation toggles are guarded by tenant-level feature flags.

add cli simulator, helm knobs, and docs

review_conversation: Ethan Cole: This looks promising — can we ensure the confidence score is deterministic across runs? I saw some jitter in the unit test harness.
Priya Shah: The score uses a fixed RNG seed derived from tenant id + epoch window; added test to validate determinism (see latest commit)
Liam O'Neill: We should be explicit about whether quant profile changes are reversible without a full restart. If not, mark as suggest-only for enterprise tenants.
Priya Shah: Agreed. Quant profile toggles are labeled as 'suggest-only' for enterprise by default; added compatibility checks and docs clarification.
Marta Ivanova: One integration test failed on the first CI run (telemetry mapping schema validation). Can you add a stricter parser and a defensive migration?
Priya Shah: Fixed parser (commit 3) and added migration tests; re-ran CI which passed.
Ethan Cole: Approving once CI green and add a short checklist for on-call playbook in case of regressions.
Priya Shah: Added an on-call playbook snippet to docs and final changelog
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (flaky test test_prefill_burst retried once)
release_notes: - Introduce Cost Weaver: tenant-specific batch/cache/quant recommendations with confidence scoring. - Add a CLI for dry-run and safe apply/rollback. - Telemetry mapping for tenant signals and helm knobs for staged rollout.
